Tests value labels against the PV

Source: R/value_labels.R
value_label_test.Rd

Compares the value labels (codes and their labels) in a field-data dataframe with the codes of the we-tags in the PV (see pv_value_labels()). One call checks all variables of a module.

Usage

value_label_test(
  data,
  pv,
  ignore = c("duration$", "_e$"),
  show_format = FALSE,
  stop_on_fail = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A neps field-data dataframe, read with haven::read_dta().

pv

The result of read_pv(), or a path (or several paths) to PV docx files.

ignore

Character vector of regular expressions. Variables in the data whose names match are not checked. Default: duration variables and variables ending in _e.

show_format

Logical, if TRUE the labels that differ only in formatting are printed as well.

stop_on_fail

Logical, if TRUE (default) the function stops with an error if a difference is found. If FALSE it only prints the results and returns the result table.

Value

Invisibly a data frame with one row per variable and code and the columns var, pv_var, code, data_label, pv_label, status ("ok", "format", "fill_in", "list", "mismatch", "missing_in_data", "not_in_pv") and item. If differences are found and stop_on_fail = TRUE, the function stops with an error after printing them.

Details

Variables are matched to the PV like in label_test(): by name, loop variables with a suffix like _1 by the name without the suffix, and variables matching ignore are skipped. The value labels in the data are the attribute labels as set by haven::read_dta(), a named vector with the codes as values and the labels as names.

For every variable and code the function checks:

  • the code is in the PV and in the data, and the labels are identical (apart from blanks): fine.

  • the labels differ only in brackets, slashes, hyphens, quotes, colons, commas or upper/lower case: fine, counted as a formatting difference. Use show_format = TRUE to list them.

  • the labels differ otherwise: ERROR.

  • the code is in the PV but has no label in the data: ERROR.

  • the code has a label in the data but is not in the PV: ERROR.

  • the label in the PV is only a fill-in like <h_etarta1>: only the code is checked, the text is listed as a NOTE.

  • the item takes its codes from a list that is not in the PV (e.g. a country list): the codes in the data that are not in the PV are not checked and counted in a NOTE. The buttons of the item are checked as usual.

Character variables (open answers) cannot carry value labels in Stata and are skipped. The function prints all differences per variable and stops at the end, like the other test functions.

See also

Other test functions: ac_test(), date_test_complex(), ef_test(), label_test()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
T_26ET <- haven::read_dta("26ET.dta")
pv_26ET <- read_pv("NEPS_B180_SC6_EP_26ET_V2_2_20250312.docx")
value_label_test(T_26ET, pv_26ET)

res <- value_label_test(T_26ET, pv_26ET, stop_on_fail = FALSE)
res[res$status != "ok", ]
} # }
